about_the_game:
In our demo, you take command of a colossal floating fortress in Skyfire: Death from Above, a real-time strategy and bullet heaven hybrid set in an alternate history where humanity has risen to the skies to survive an endless war.

Collect and manage resources to build and customize your floating fortress, adapting defensive and offensive modules to face growing threats. Design the ultimate citadel, capable of withstanding any siege and dominating the skies.

Venture into a war-torn world, where the skies are the new battlefield. Discover valuable resources, face unique challenges, and unravel the secrets of a world in constant conflict.

Engage in intense aerial battles, utilizing tactical skills and real-time strategies to overcome your enemies. Adapt your tactics to each encounter, from swarms of light fighters to colossal rivals.

Demo Gameplay

  • Collect and manage resources

  • Venture into a war-torn world

  • Engage in intense aerial battles against hordes of enemies

  • Command your fleet and dominate the skies!

  • Play Level 1: The Cloudveil Mountains

The player’s journey begins deep in the far mountains, where the first scouts of the Restoration fleet have been deployed. In the distance, the facility towers can be seen as colossal structures between the mountains. 

  • Play Level 2: Fallen Factory

The castle is finally inside the factory. This is the heart of the restoration army, and also its most valuable and defended point.

  • Play Level 3: Eye of the Storm

The castle escapes victorious from the crumbling facility. Now, only a remaining enemy stands: another flying castle, sided with the restoration.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GBVRAM / DirectX 10+ support
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 3.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GBVRAM / DirectX 10+ support
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes

short_description: Build and upgrade your flying castle, defend yourself against enemy hordes and explore a medieval post-apocalyptic world. Experience the fusion of Bullet Heaven, and real time strategy. In a world where machines have taken over, mankind has taken to the skies.
